boundary: This proves existence of a large C5-equivariant map space, not a canonical map. Choosing an order-five subgroup and a vector in the 144-dimensional Hom space breaks the full 2.U4(2)/U4(2) symmetry; no physical coupling is identified.

source_carriers.E8_real8: The faithful integral real carrier is chi21+chi22 of 2.U4(2); the ATLAS standard order-five generator in chi21 has characteristic polynomial Phi5, and chi22 is its complex conjugate.
source_carriers.coexact90: The literal signed-edge projector has rank 90 and trace zero on every nonidentity power of the unique order-five class of U4(2).

split_subgroup.reason: Odd order avoids the central involution; U4(2) has one order-five conjugacy class, and an order-five element partitions the 40 W33 points into eight pentagons.

theorem: The central-character obstruction disappears on the distinguished order-five split subgroup. The real E8 carrier restricts as two copies of each nontrivial C5 character, while the coexact 90 restricts as eighteen copies of every C5 character. Consequently both C5-equivariant Hom spaces have dimension 144.
